Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for lining this up. We want to run a quick 45-minute rehearsal with your demo leads + CloudBridge to validate the data flow, SSO handoff, and the scripted failover path (Redwood hosted -> CloudBridge-managed fallback). Primary goals: brief run through of slide deck, dry-run of live model calls, and contingency fallbacks.

Attached is a short agenda (nebula_rehearsal_agenda_v1.pdf) and a proposed checklist. Our team is distributed across Milan and London; timezone-friendly windows for us are 9:30–12:00 CET or 14:00–17:00 CET. Can you propose 2 options next week?

Participants we expect: Elena (Nebula), Akash (SolarSystems — SI), CloudBridge PM, Redwood demo lead (you'll own).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood bring the runbook stub (KV caching/latency knobs + fallback mapping) for the rehearsal?
- Can CloudBridge confirm if they need any sample keys or ephemeral accounts to test the handoff?

Cheers,
Elena

- Vanessa will own the runbook doc; Vivek will bring the latency/backoff knobs and quantization profile we'll demo.
- We need a sample API key and a small dataset from Nebula to reproduce Nebula's tokenization edge-case (Elena, is this possible?).

1) Wed Jul 1 — 16:00–16:45 EDT (21:00–21:45 CET) — late for EU, but OK if you prefer evening.
2) Thu Jul 2 — 10:30–11:15 EDT (15:30–16:15 CET) — aligns better for Milan/London.
